fusions.name: Bare Stalks
fusions.desc: Looses a stripping swarm in a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 25 damage to everything caught in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 4% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hopping Swarmer
fusions.desc: Flings a locust that deals 6 damage to the first enemy it meets, then hops to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each hit dealing 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Cloud Descends
fusions.desc: Takes 0.3 seconds to loose a cloud for 10 seconds that bites an enemy within 6 tiles for 3 damage every 0.8 seconds. You move 20% faster for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Onward to Greener Rows
fusions.desc: Every kill builds a stack on you, up to 3. At 3 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (14% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
